faqs.q: What are Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft used for?
faqs.a: A container lifting frame connects to the four top corner castings with the legs vertical, so the container carries no side load. Standard frames use manual twistlocks or hooks; semi-automatic frames lock and release the twistlocks from the frame, so no one has to climb onto the container.

faqs.q: What sizes can Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft be supplied in?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft can be supplied in the size you need (20 ft and 40 ft ISO containers). Tell us the size or capacity you need, and the application, through the enquiry and we confirm the dimensions and the part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What do I need to send for Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft to be sized and quoted?
faqs.a: For Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft, send us the load weight and where its centre of gravity sits, the load's length and width, the positions of its lifting points, the crane hook height and any headroom limit. And the environment the equipment will work in (indoor, outdoor, offshore, hazardous area). A drawing, a 3D model or a photo of the load is the quickest way to start.

faqs.q: What working load limit do Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft have?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft are engineered to order, so the working load limit is set by the design for your load and is stated as "to order" in the listing. The rated load is marked on each item and agreed on the general arrangement drawing before anything is made; it is never inferred from a standard size.

faqs.q: Can Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft be designed for offshore use?
faqs.a: For Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft, yes. Offshore designs to DNV standards, with witnessed testing and the documentation the project asks for, are available on request.

faqs.q: What are Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft made from, and what finish does it have?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft are fabricated from Structural steel, grade to the design, with the finish being a paint system to your specification; galvanized for outdoor use on request.

faqs.q: Are Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft certified, and to which standard?
faqs.a: For Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft, engineered below-the-hook equipment is built to order. Your enquiry is reviewed by the maker's design engineers, who issue a general arrangement drawing for your approval before anything is made. Each item is designed to EN 13155, load tested before dispatch and supplied with a declaration of conformity, a test certificate and user instructions. Design calculations, material certificates, NDT records and third-party witnessed testing can be added to the order, and offshore designs to DNV standards are available on request. We confirm the lead time with the quotation.

faqs.q: What do Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft connect to or work with?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft connect the load to the crane hook, so the hook, slings and shackles above them must be rated at least equal to the design load. See our [lifting beams and spreader frames](/c/spreader-beams) for other below-the-hook equipment.

faqs.q: How should Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft need a pre-use check before every lift and periodic thorough examination by a competent person. Rated load, identification and test date are marked on the equipment and the user instructions state how it may be rigged.

faqs.q: Where are Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft typically used?
faqs.a: For Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft, Reduced-headroom frames lift a 40 ft container in a building or under a gantry with little height to spare. One-over-two systems hang two spreaders under a third.

faqs.q: Can Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft be supplied to customers outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, and ship them with export documents prepared for the destination once they are built. Give us the delivery country, load and drawing details through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time together with the price.

faqs.q: What is the lead time and how do I get a quotation for Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft?
faqs.a: Container Lifting Frames, 20 ft & 40 ft are made to order, so the lead time is confirmed with the quotation: contact us for current lead time. Send the load, dimensions and any documentation you need through [our contact page](/contact) and we reply with a price and a lead time.
